title: Driver resources
summary: For a WiFi adapter whose driver is not in the kernel, or that starts as a USB drive: DKMS and the kernel's headers to build a driver on the box, usb-modeswitch, firmware for common adapters, and where the drivers come from.
consent: A driver built here runs inside the kernel as root, with full control of the box. irate-box has tested only the versions linked below. DKMS brings a compiler with it, so any user with a shell can build and run programs on the box.
notes: The Network page names each WiFi adapter's chip, and says when its driver is not in the kernel.
To build a driver: download its source (a link below), then follow its instructions. DKMS builds it for this kernel and builds it again for each new kernel.
While DKMS has a driver registered, the box keeps the packages that driver needs when the toolkit is removed. Removing dkms by hand (apt-get remove dkms) also removes the driver.
The kernel's headers come with the toolkit: the package that holds them on this board, found when the toolkit is fetched.

Firmware for common adapters is cached with the toolkit. Install the one an adapter needs: firmware-atheros (AR9271), firmware-realtek (RTL8188, RTL8192 and RTL88xx), firmware-misc-nonfree (MediaTek, Ralink).
An AIC8800 adapter that shows as a USB drive (USB ID a69c:5721): run sudo eject on its drive (lsblk lists it as a small flash drive). It then shows as a WiFi adapter.

An AIC8800D80 seen as USB ID 368b:8d81 with no WiFi interface: its driver lacks that ID. Run echo '368b 8d81 ff a69c 8d81' | sudo tee /sys/bus/usb/drivers/aic8800_fdrv/new_id after the driver is loaded. It lasts until the next restart.

links.title: USB WiFi adapters on Linux (morrownr)
links.note: The best-known community list of which USB WiFi adapters work on Linux, and with which driver. Read it before you buy an adapter.

links.title: AIC8800 driver and firmware (Radxa)
links.note: Tested by irate-box on a Raspberry Pi 3B+ (an AIC8800D80 dongle) and the Luckfox Lyra Zero W (its built-in AIC8800DC). Install aic8800-firmware and aic8800-usb-dkms from the release.
